lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where three public hearings on second reading include a deed-restriction amendment that would convert two affordable ownership units at 215 East Colorado Avenue into employee dwelling units and remove the maximum sale price — a structural change to how those units work in our housing stock. The Telluride Housing Authority takes up the same question Monday. Norwood's Planning and Zoning Commission also meets Sunday to review and potentially adopt Phase I of a Land Use Code rewrite, the kind of thing that shapes development rules for years to come.

notable.stake: Vote to adopt Norwood Land Use Code amendments sets long-term development rules.
